notes.title: Version update content and compensation description
notes.notes:
The following are specific game changes:

1. In game currency increase:

● add a brand-new vona currency: Prayer stone, which is used to extract relevant contents of vona

● acquisition method: recharge with steam wallet, achievement reward, weekly task reward, activity reward, official distribution, etc. in the blessing store

● add a new mall to exchange currency: blessing fragments, which are used to exchange skin, chessboard, self machine and other related new contents

● acquisition method: praying, receiving, activity reward, official distribution, etc

2. Fengna relevant:

● after the free version is updated, a new fengna mode will be added: pray for fengna

● the prayer stone can be used to extract the prayer stone, which can be extracted once for every 100 prayer stones.

● probability of blessing receiving: chessboard 2%, self machine 2%, skin 4%, expression 20%, avatar 32%, avatar frame 40%

● minimum guarantee method of blessing mode: when the number of offerings reaches 60, one of the up items will appear. When the number of offerings reaches 120, you will get an opportunity to exchange convertible items in the current period. After 120 times of giving, you can't continue to give until you exchange the items. After the exchange is completed, the times will be cleared and the times will be recalculated.

● items extracted in blessing mode, if owned, will be automatically converted into blessing fragments. The chessboard and the self machine will be converted into 50 blessing fragments,

● the skin will be transformed into 25 blessing fragments, and the avatar, expression and avatar frame will be transformed into 1 blessing fragment

3. Store addition:

● add a new exchange currency: blessing fragments

● chessboard open exchange

● add new skin

4. Game mode conversion compensation and reward:

● after entering the game, all players can charge free version update benefits: 2000 blessing stone + 1W gold coin + 1000 belief stone, which will be distributed by email

● players who have purchased the game and entered the game before the free version update will receive an additional compensation of 2000 blessing stone + 5000 gold coins + 1000 faith stone, which will be distributed by mail

5. Achievement, DLC gift package change related compensation:

● change the achievement reward, increase the gift of Blessing Stone and change the number of copper coins. Players who have completed relevant achievements will receive corresponding Blessing Stone compensation

(for example, the red murderer has increased the gift of 1000 blessing stones. If the player has completed this achievement, he will directly receive the compensation of 1000 blessing stones)

6. Novice player benefits and long-term return compensation

● after the free version is updated, if the season score is less than 300 points, you will only encounter simple man-machine players and players with the same score less than 300 points. When the score reaches 300 points, you will directly receive 1000 Blessing Stone novice players,

This reward will only be obtained when you reach 300 points for the first time. Even if the points are cleared again in the future season, you will not get this reward again

● players who have been offline for more than 60 days will receive return compensation after online: 1000 blessing stone + 1W gold coin + 1000 belief stone

7. Change of weekly task reward

● the reward of weekly regular tasks will be converted from copper coins to blessing stones, and at least 300 blessing stones will be obtained if all tasks are completed every week

8. Season point settlement

● this free version will settle the last season and give corresponding rewards to all players who have the points of the last season:

ranking Blessing Stone skin head portrait title

1~10 three thousand Ghosts are good and evil Ghosts, good and evil autumn - Avatar Crazy witch

10~50 two thousand and five hundred Ghosts are good and evil Ghosts, good and evil autumn - Avatar Sanctioned monster

50~100 two thousand Ghosts are good and evil Ghosts, good and evil autumn - Avatar God from heaven

100~500 one thousand and six hundred Ghosts are good and evil Ghosts, good and evil autumn - Avatar Mad ghost man

500~1000 one thousand and two hundred Ghosts are good and evil Ghosts, good and evil autumn - Avatar Happy goblin

1000~3000 1000 Ghost human good and evil autumn - Avatar happy goblin

3000~ one thousand Happy goblin

● at the same time, because this ranking takes too long, all players who have corresponding points before the free version will be compensated and will receive double the blessing stone reward

(for example, the ranking of points this season is 18. In addition to 2500 blessing stones, autumn skin avatars of ghosts and evil people, and sanctioned monsters, they will also receive an additional compensation of 2500 blessing stones)

9. Extra games after the season

● the top 24 players will be informed by season ranking email (if the number is not enough, it will be supplemented by subsequent ranking players). These 24 players will conduct additional events within one or two weeks after the settlement of the ranking list, with a total schedule of two days.

(the specific competition arrangement will be detailed in the follow-up announcement)

● confirmation of participation in the competition will be made by email

10. New skin and self-made voting activities

● it will be voted one week after the free version, and the vote will decide the production of new self-made machine and new skin

● voting roles will be proposed by playoff players. Each player can propose two roles, one for skin voting and one for self voting

● the proposed role can only be the role owned in the current game, and the self machine cannot propose the role that has become self machine at present.

● the specific activity mode will be detailed in the follow-up announcement
